lines.gurmukhi: ਘਰੁ ਦਰੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਮਹਲੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: ghar dar paavai mahal naam piaariaa ||
lines.translation: He obtains his own home and mansion, by loving the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਉ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਵਾਰਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh paaiaa naam hau gur kau vaariaa ||
lines.translation: As Gurmukh, I have obtained the Naam; I am a sacrifice to the Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਆਪਿ ਸਵਾਰਹਿ ਆਪਿ ਸਿਰਜਨਹਾਰਿਆ ॥੧੬॥
lines.transliteration: too aap savaarahi aap sirajanahaariaa ||16||
lines.translation: You Yourself embellish and adorn us, O Creator Lord. ||16||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
lines.translation: Salok, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੀਵਾ ਬਲੈ ਅੰਧੇਰਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: deevaa balai a(n)dheraa jaai ||
lines.translation: When the lamp is lit, the darkness is dispelled;

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੇਦ ਪਾਠ ਮਤਿ ਪਾਪਾ ਖਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: bed paath mat paapaa khaai ||
lines.translation: reading the Vedas, sinful intellect is destroyed.

lines.gurmukhi: ਉਗਵੈ ਸੂਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਪੈ ਚੰਦੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: ugavai soor na jaapai cha(n)d ||
lines.translation: When the sun rises, the moon is not visible.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਗਿਆਨ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਮਿਟੰਤੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: jah giaan pragaas agiaan mita(n)t ||
lines.translation: Wherever spiritual wisdom appears, ignorance is dispelled.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੇਦ ਪਾਠ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਕੀ ਕਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: bed paath sa(n)saar kee kaar ||
lines.translation: Reading the Vedas is the world's occupation;

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੜੑਿ ਪੜੑਿ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਕਰਹਿ ਬੀਚਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: paRhi paRhi pa(n)dit karahi beechaar ||
lines.translation: the Pandits read them, study them and contemplate them.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਬੂਝੇ ਸਭ ਹੋਇ ਖੁਆਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: bin boojhe sabh hoi khuaar ||
lines.translation: Without understanding, all are ruined.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਉਤਰਸਿ ਪਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak guramukh utaras paar ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the Gurmukh is carried across. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 1 ||
lines.translation: First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੈ ਸਾਦੁ ਨ ਆਇਓ ਨਾਮਿ ਨ ਲਗੋ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabadai saad na aaio naam na lago piaar ||
lines.translation: Those who do not savor the Word of the Shabad, do not love the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਸਨਾ ਫਿਕਾ ਬੋਲਣਾ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਹੋਇ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: rasanaa phikaa bolanaa nit nit hoi khuaar ||
lines.translation: They speak insipidly with their tongues, and are continually disgraced.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪਇਐ ਕਿਰਤਿ ਕਮਾਵਣਾ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਮੇਟਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak paiai kirat kamaavanaa koi na metanahaar ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, they act according to the karma of their past actions, which no one can erase. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੇ ਆਪਣਾ ਸੋ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: j prabh saalaahe aapanaa so sobhaa paae ||
lines.translation: One who praises his God, receives honor.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਦੂਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਸਚੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: haumai vichahu door kar sach ma(n)n vasaae ||
lines.translation: He drives out egotism from within himself, and enshrines the True Name within his mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਬਾਣੀ ਗੁਣ ਉਚਰੈ ਸਚਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: sach baanee gun ucharai sachaa sukh paae ||
lines.translation: Through the True Word of the Guru's Bani, he chants the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and finds true peace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਲੁ ਭਇਆ ਚਿਰੀ ਵਿਛੁੰਨਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਪੁਰਖਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: mel bhaiaa chiree vichhu(n)niaa gur purakh milaae ||
lines.translation: He is united with the Lord, after being separated for so long; the Guru, the Primal Being, unites him with the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਮੈਲਾ ਇਵ ਸੁਧੁ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ॥੧੭॥
lines.transliteration: man mailaa iv sudh hai har naam dhiaae ||17||
lines.translation: In this way, his filthy mind is cleansed and purified, and he meditates on the Name of the Lord. ||17||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
lines.translation: Salok, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਇਆ ਕੂਮਲ ਫੁਲ ਗੁਣ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਪਸਿ ਮਾਲ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaaiaa koomal phul gun naanak gupas maal ||
lines.translation: With the fresh leaves of the body, and the flowers of virtue, Nanak has weaved his garland.

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਨੀ ਫੁਲੀ ਰਉ ਕਰੇ ਅਵਰ ਕਿ ਚੁਣੀਅਹਿ ਡਾਲ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: enee phulee rau kare avar k chuneeahi daal ||1||
lines.translation: The Lord is pleased with such garlands, so why pick any other flowers? ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਹਲਾ ੨ ॥
lines.transliteration: mahalaa 2 ||
lines.translation: Second Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨਾ ਬਸੰਤੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਨੑ ਘਰਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਕੰਤੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanak tinaa basa(n)t hai jinh ghar vasiaa ka(n)t ||
lines.translation: O Nanak, it is the spring season for those, within whose homes their Husband Lord abides.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕੇ ਕੰਤ ਦਿਸਾਪੁਰੀ ਸੇ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਜਲੰਤ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: jin ke ka(n)t disaapuree se ahinis phirahi jala(n)t ||2||
lines.translation: But those, whose Husband Lord is far away in distant lands, continue burning, day and night. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸੇ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape bakhase daiaa kar gur satigur bachanee ||
lines.translation: The Merciful Lord Himself forgives those who dwell upon the Word of the Guru, the True Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸੇਵੀ ਗੁਣ ਰਵਾ ਮਨੁ ਸਚੈ ਰਚਨੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: anadin sevee gun ravaa man sachai rachanee ||
lines.translation: Night and day, I serve the True Lord, and chant His Glorious Praises; my mind merges into Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਬੇਅੰਤੁ ਹੈ ਅੰਤੁ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਲਖਨੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: prabh meraa bea(n)t hai a(n)t kinai na lakhanee ||
lines.translation: My God is infinite; no one knows His limit.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਗਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਤ ਜਪਨੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur charanee lagiaa har naam nit japanee ||
lines.translation: Grasping hold of the feet of the True Guru, meditate continually on the Lord's Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਇਛੈ ਸੋ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਸੀ ਸਭਿ ਘਰੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਜਚਨੀ ॥੧੮॥
lines.transliteration: jo ichhai so phal paaisee sabh gharai vich jachanee ||18||
lines.translation: Thus you shall obtain the fruits of your desires, and all wishes shall be fulfilled within your home. ||18||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
lines.translation: Salok, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਹਿਲ ਬਸੰਤੈ ਆਗਮਨਿ ਪਹਿਲਾ ਮਉਲਿਓ ਸੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: pahil basa(n)tai aagaman pahilaa maulio soi ||
lines.translation: Spring brings forth the first blossoms, but the Lord blossoms earlier still.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਮਉਲਿਐ ਸਭ ਮਉਲੀਐ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਨ ਮਉਲਿਹੁ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jit mauliai sabh mauleeai tisahi na maulihu koi ||1||
lines.translation: By His blossoming, everything blossoms; no one else causes Him to blossom forth. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 2 ||
lines.translation: Second Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਹਿਲ ਬਸੰਤੈ ਆਗਮਨਿ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: pahil basa(n)tai aagaman tis kaa karahu beechaar ||
lines.translation: He blossoms forth even earlier than the spring; reflect upon Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਜਿ ਸਭਸੈ ਦੇ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak so saalaaheeai j sabhasai de aadhaar ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, praise the One who gives Support to all. ||2||

lines.transliteration: mah 2 ||
lines.translation: Second Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿਐ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਨਾ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਜੇ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: miliai miliaa naa milai milai miliaa je hoi ||
lines.translation: By uniting, the united one is not united; he unites, only if he is united.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰ ਆਤਮੈ ਜੋ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਕਹੀਐ ਸੋਇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)tar aatamai jo milai miliaa kaheeai soi ||3||
lines.translation: But if he unites deep within his soul, then he is said to be united. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹੀਐ ਸਚੁ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: har har naam salaaheeai sach kaar kamaavai ||
lines.translation: Praise the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, and practice truthful deeds.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੂਜੀ ਕਾਰੈ ਲਗਿਆ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੋਨੀ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: doojee kaarai lagiaa phir jonee paavai ||
lines.translation: Attached to other deeds, one is consigned to wander in reincarnation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤਿਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਾਮੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: naam ratiaa naam paaeeai naame gun gaavai ||
lines.translation: Attuned to the Name, one obtains the Name, and through the Name, sings the Lord's Praises.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਲਾਹੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad salaaheeai har naam samaavai ||
lines.translation: Praising the Word of the Guru's Shabad, he merges in the Lord's Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਸਫਲ ਹੈ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਫਲ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੧੯॥
lines.transliteration: satigur sevaa saphal hai seviai phal paavai ||19||
lines.translation: Service to the True Guru is fruitful and rewarding; serving Him, the fruits are obtained. ||19||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੨ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 2 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Second Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਸ ਹੀ ਕੋਈ ਕੋਇ ਮੰਞੁ ਨਿਮਾਣੀ ਇਕੁ ਤੂ ॥
lines.transliteration: kis hee koee koi ma(n)nj nimaanee ik too ||
lines.translation: Some people have others, but I am forlorn and dishonored; I have only You, Lord.
